import { motion, useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig } from 'motion/react'
import { useId, type ElementType, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { BentoCard, BentoGrid } from '@/components/bento-grid'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

export interface FeatureBentoItem {
  /** Short name of the feature. */
  title: string
  /** One or two sentences. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Small icon before the title. */
  icon?: ReactNode
  /** Decorative artwork that fills the free space of the tile. */
  visual?: ReactNode
  /** Columns the tile spans on wide containers. */
  colSpan?: 1 | 2 | 3
  /** Rows the tile spans on wide containers. */
  rowSpan?: 1 | 2
  /** Makes the whole tile a link. */
  href?: string
}

export interface FeaturesBentoProps {
  /** Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech. */
  title: ReactNode
  /** Copy under the headline. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Small pill above the headline. */
  eyebrow?: ReactNode
  /** The tiles, in reading order. The grid packs them densely. */
  features: FeatureBentoItem[]
  /** Minimum height of one grid row, any CSS length. */
  rowHeight?: string
  /** Element for the headline. */
  titleAs?: ElementType
  /** Element for the root. */
  as?: ElementType
  /** Seconds the grid takes to fade in. */
  duration?: number
  /** Turns the entrance animation off. */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}

/** A left-aligned headline over a bento grid of feature tiles. Built on Bento Grid. */
export function FeaturesBento({
  title,
  description,
  eyebrow,
  features,
  rowHeight = '12rem',
  titleAs: Title = 'h2',
  as: Tag = 'section',
  duration = 0.6,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: FeaturesBentoProps) {
  const id = useId()
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const animate = !disabled && !reduced

  return (
    <Tag aria-labelledby={id} className={cn('@container w-full', className)}>
      <div className="mb-10 grid gap-4 @3xl:grid-cols-[1fr_minmax(0,28rem)] @3xl:items-end @3xl:gap-12">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4">
          {eyebrow != null && <span className="text-sm font-medium text-primary">{eyebrow}</span>}
          <Title id={id} className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance text-foreground @xl:text-4xl">
            {title}
          </Title>
        </div>
        {description != null && <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-pretty text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <motion.div
        initial={animate ? { opacity: 0, y: 24 } : false}
        whileInView={animate ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : undefined}
        viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-60px' }}
        transition={{ duration, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
      >
        <BentoGrid columns={3} rowHeight={rowHeight}>
          {features.map((f) => (
            <BentoCard
              key={f.title}
              title={f.title}
              description={f.description}
              icon={f.icon}
              visual={f.visual}
              colSpan={f.colSpan}
              rowSpan={f.rowSpan}
              href={f.href}
            />
          ))}
        </BentoGrid>
      </motion.div>
    </Tag>
  )
}

// Source: educlopez/smoothui (MIT) — https://github.com/educlopez/smoothui/blob/main/packages/smoothui/blocks/features/features-2/index.tsx
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { FeaturesBento } from '@/components/features-bento'

const Icon = ({ d }: { d: string }): ReactNode => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d={d} />
  </svg>
)

const BARS = [38, 52, 44, 66, 58, 74, 62, 88, 71, 96, 84, 100]

function AnalyticsVisual() {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-3 p-5">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
        <span className="text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-foreground">$48,219</span>
        <span className="rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-primary">+12.4%</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-end gap-1.5">
        {BARS.map((h, i) => (
          <span key={i} style={{ height: `${h}%` }} className={`flex-1 rounded-t-sm ${i === BARS.length - 1 ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-primary/20'}`} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const Dots = () => (
  <div className="grid h-full grid-cols-6 content-center gap-2 p-5">
    {Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => (
      <span key={i} className={`aspect-square rounded-full ${i % 5 === 0 ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-muted-foreground/20'}`} />
    ))}
  </div>
)

const Lines = () => (
  <div className="space-y-2.5 p-5">
    {[78, 56, 90, 42].map((w, i) => (
      <span key={i} style={{ width: `${w}%` }} className="block h-2 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/20" />
    ))}
  </div>
)

export default function FeaturesBentoDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl">
      <FeaturesBento
        eyebrow="Platform"
        title="One workspace, every part of the product"
        description="From first idea to production traffic, each piece is designed to fit the others."
        features={[
          { title: 'Smart analytics', description: 'Real-time metrics with charts you can actually read.', icon: <Icon d="M4 20V10m6 10V4m6 16v-7m4 7H2" />, visual: <AnalyticsVisual />, colSpan: 2, rowSpan: 2 },
          { title: 'Team collaboration', description: 'Comment, share and review in the same place.', icon: <Icon d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2m18 0v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87M14 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75M9 11a4 4 0 1 0 0-8 4 4 0 0 0 0 8z" />, visual: <Dots /> },
          { title: 'API first', description: 'A documented REST API and typed SDKs.', icon: <Icon d="m8 6-6 6 6 6m8-12 6 6-6 6" />, visual: <Lines /> },
          { title: 'Global delivery', description: 'Served from the edge location nearest to each visitor.', icon: <Icon d="M12 2a10 10 0 1 0 0 20 10 10 0 0 0 0-20zM2 12h20M12 2c3 3 3 17 0 20M12 2c-3 3-3 17 0 20" /> },
          { title: 'Secure by default', description: 'Encryption at rest and in transit, audit logs included.', icon: <Icon d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z" />, colSpan: 2 },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
